name: get_hub_status
description: Read the current status of the named FarmWiz Control Hub without changing any device state.

hub.description: Exact hub ID from the current saved device list

name: get_sensor_state
description: Read sensor values from a named FarmWiz ESP32 node without changing any device state.

name: list_schedules
description: List schedules currently stored on the named FarmWiz Control Hub without changing them.

hub.description: Exact hub ID from the current saved device list

name: set_relay
description: Turn one named FarmWiz relay on or off. Relay must be 1, 2, 3, or 4. An optional duration in seconds turns it off after the duration. This changes physical device state and must be confirmed by the Orchestrator.

hub.description: Exact hub ID from the current saved device list

duration_seconds.description: Optional automatic shutoff duration in seconds

name: set_schedule
description: Create a recurring relay schedule on a named FarmWiz Control Hub. Use a start time such as 06:30, an interval in minutes, and an on duration in minutes. This changes physical device scheduling and must be confirmed by the Orchestrator.

hub.description: Exact hub ID from the current saved device list

target.description: Named plant group or node, for example tomatoes

duration_minutes.description: How many minutes the relay stays on
